---
title: "xucomm"
---

## Description

Creates CO domain records from the dataset.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset to get comments from

  *Required:* Yes

**`invar`**

: Name of the input variable to get comments from

  *Required:* Yes

**`idvar`**

: Name of the id variable

  *Required:* No

**`qc`**

: Flag to indicate if macro is used on QC side

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xucomm(dm,dmcomm);
%xucomm(qclb,lbcomm,idvar=lbseq,qc=Y);
```
